expected_mechanism.summary: Under CONFIG_DISABLE_ENVIRON=y at pre-fix SHA 526ba1ab343a00b2e1801e089392eed64758b820: (1) libs/libc/unistd/lib_getcwd.c is enclosed by a whole-file '#ifndef CONFIG_DISABLE_ENVIRON' ... '#endif' so no line of the file compiles; (2) Make.defs and CMakeLists.txt include lib_getcwd.c only inside the NOT-DISABLE_ENVIRON conditional block, so the TU is excluded from the build under y; net effect: the POSIX API getcwd() has no definition in the linked image, so any consumer resolves to a link-time undefined reference / unresolvable API although <unistd.h> declares it. Compounding: CONFIG_LIBC_HOMEDIR carries 'depends on !DISABLE_ENVIRON' in libs/libc/stdlib/Kconfig, so the home-dir default is unavailable in the same config.
expected_mechanism.fix_summary: Fix 67ed036227b14bbab01b63801bfd7e218dfd6107 makes the definition unconditional, narrows the guard to the getenv("PWD") fallback only, moves lib_getcwd.c into the unconditional source lists (removed from the conditional block), and removes the LIBC_HOMEDIR Kconfig dependency.
expected_mechanism.determinism: compile/link-time deterministic under the pinned build context; no runtime state participates
